title: Retrieval-grounded robot program generation and simulation-based correction via Model Context Protocol
abstract: arXiv:2608.21417v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Flexible manufacturing requires industrial robots to be reprogrammed rapidly as product variants change. This paper presents a language-model-based workflow that generates, validates, and iteratively corrects ABB RAPID robot programs from natural language task descriptions. A dual-stream retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline grounds code generation in verified technical documentation and production templates, reducing domain-specific errors produced by ungrounded language models. A custom Model Context Protocol (MCP) server connects the language-model client directly to ABB RobotStudio for automated code upload, simulation execution, and diagnostic feedback. The evaluation combines a 30-query retrieval benchmark, scoped code-generation checks, and RobotStudio case studies in a simulated pickand- place manufacturing cell. translated_title: 基于检索的机器人程序生成与通过模型上下文协议的仿真校正
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21417v1 公告类型：新 摘要：柔性制造要求工业机器人随着产品变体的变化而快速重新编程。本文提出了一种基于语言模型的工作流程，该流程能够从自然语言任务描述中生成、验证并迭代修正ABBRAPID机器人程序。一种双流检索增强生成（RAG）流水线将代码生成锚定在经核实的技术文档和生产模板中，减少了未接地语言模型产生的特定领域错误。一个自定义模型上下文协议（MCP）服务器将语言模型客户端直接连接到ABB RobotStudio，实现自动代码上传、仿真执行和诊断反馈。评估结合了30个查询的检索基准、范围限定的代码生成检查，以及在模拟拾放制造单元中的RobotStudio案例研究。仿真循环暴露了静态和语义检查无法捕获的执行失败，包括s。
tldr: 本文通过双流RAG和MCP服务器集成ABB RobotStudio仿真，实现了从自然语言生成并自动校正机器人程序，解决了传统检查无法发现的执行问题。
en_tdlr: This paper integrates dual-stream RAG with an MCP server for ABB RobotStudio simulation, enabling natural-language-driven robot program generation and iterative correction, addressing execution failures undetectable by static checks.
